item.title: Greggs to hike prices on several menu favourites in just DAYS
item.description: Greggs has confirmed prices on several of its favourite menu items will rise before the end of December, marking the fourth time the bakery chain has increased prices in 2025.The company said the latest changes would come into effect later this month.They told customers they should expect “small price changes” across parts of its range.The bakery chain said the increases are due to continued pressure from rising costs and inflation affecting the business. item.title: Labour urged to use Brexit freedoms to ignore EU amid major car ban decision - 'Risks slowing progress'
